notes: Researched Baidu Qianfan (cloud.baidu.com/doc/WENXINWORKSHOP, intl.cloud.baidu.com/en/doc/qianfan Deep Thinking doc Wm95lyynv-intl-en, model list rmh4stp0j), the ERNIE open-model announcement (ai.baidu.com/ai-doc/WENXINWORKSHOP/4mchtzl8s), FastDeploy/vLLM reasoning docs, and HF cards (baidu/ERNIE-4.5-VL-28B-A3B). Toggle key verified: Qianfan /v2/chat/completions uses a top-level boolean 'enable_thinking' (default false; only ernie-5.0-thinking-preview defaults true); the official enable_thinking support list contains only ernie-4.5-turbo-vl-preview, ernie-4.5-turbo-vl-32k-preview, ernie-4.5-vl-28b-a3b and ernie-5.0-thinking-preview among ERNIE models (HF card confirms VL-28B 'supports both thinking and non-thinking modes' via enable_thinking). Hence hybrid off/on toggles were added ONLY to ernie-4.5-vl-28b-a3b and ernie-4.5-vl-424b-a47b; always-on single modes (strategy effort high, matching the project's established convention and the merged catalog) were added/confirmed for the thinking variants ernie-4.5-21b-a3b-thinking, ernie-4.5-vl-28b-a3b-thinking, ernie-5.0-thinking-preview, ernie-5.1:thinking and ernie-x1.1-preview. DELIBERATE OMISSIONS vs the brief: ernie-4.5-21b-a3b, ernie-4.5-300b-a47b and ernie-4.5-300b-a47b-paddle and ernie-5.1 received NO thinking toggle because official docs show no deep thinking on these base models — the ERNIE open-model announcement lists ernie-4.5-21b-a3b as a plain dialog model (deep thinking only on the -thinking model ID), and the Qianfan model list (updated 2026-08-06) places ernie-5.1 only in text-generation flagship, NOT in the deep-thinking category, with enable_thinking undocumented for it (per PATCH_SPEC, official docs win over the brief and the conflict is noted). knowledge_cutoff set to 2025-03 for the four ERNIE 4.5 models that lacked it, inferred from the same-series siblings already in the catalog (ERNIE-4.5-21B-A3B=2025-03, ERNIE-4.5-VL-424B-A47B=2025-03-31); Baidu does not publish cutoffs, so it is omitted for ernie-5.1, ernie-5.1:thinking and ernie-x1.1-preview (officially undisclosed). open_weights set true for ernie-4.5-300b-a47b and ernie-4.5-vl-424b-a47b per Baidu's announcement that all five ERNIE 4.5 models are open-source (Apache-2.0), corroborated by models.dev novita/openrouter/jiekou. Context/token limits left unchanged: native VL-28B context is 131072 (HF card) and VL-424B is 131072 (FastDeploy), but the catalog's existing serving-configured values (vl-28b-a3b ctx=30000, vl-424b ctx=123000) were not overridden because the public Qianfan listing for these specific model IDs could not be retrieved and existing values are conservative. No speed_modes added: Baidu expresses speed via separate model IDs (-fast/-turbo variants), and no request-level speed parameter is documented. Existing pricing and release_date left as-is (already present and consistent with models.dev). All other fields unchanged.
